status: re-reading of phase 4's stored regimens under a delay between killing and release; no dose re-solved, no parameter of the bacterial or release layers changed
endpoint: plasma endotoxin above the pre-treatment level, uncalibrated units; windows are AUCs from the first dose

delay_structure.equations: A_1' = r_lysis - (n/MTT) A_1; A_i' = (n/MTT)(A_{i-1} - A_i); D' = (n/MTT) A_n + r_filament - k D
delay_structure.source: Thorsted A et al. Antimicrob Agents Chemother 2020;64:e02070-19, PMC7179275, Results and Table 1: one transit compartment for release after antibiotic-induced killing of susceptible and filamentous cells; growth-associated release immediate
delay_structure.approx_interval_method: Wald interval on the transit rate, rate x (1 +/- 1.96 RSE), inverted
delay_structure.filament_term: kept immediate: in this model it is release from surviving filamenting cells, not release on killing; one variant delays it as well

numerical_check.method: closed-form integration (matrix exponential per step) of the transit chain and the endotoxin compartment over the same piecewise-linear release input the ODE solver interpolates

provenance.note: Delay between killing and endotoxin release, re-reading phase 4 regimens
